---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for Schist
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement", "needs-triage"]
assignees: []
---

## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see in Schist.

## Problem/Use Case
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

**Describe your use case:**
- What are you trying to accomplish?
- Who would benefit from this feature?
- How often would you use this feature?

## Proposed Solution
**Describe the solution you'd like:**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**User Experience:**
Describe how users would interact with this feature:
1. User does X
2. System responds with Y
3. User sees Z

## Schist Context
**Which area of Schist would this affect?**
- [ ] Document editing/creation
- [ ] Wiki linking and navigation
- [ ] Search functionality
- [ ] Authentication/user management
- [ ] File management/organization
- [ ] Version control/history
- [ ] GitHub integration
- [ ] Public sharing
- [ ] UI/UX improvements
- [ ] Performance optimization
- [ ] Security enhancements
- [ ] API/integrations
- [ ] Templates system
- [ ] Mobile/responsive design
- [ ] Keyboard shortcuts
- [ ] Configuration/setup
- [ ] Other: ___________

**Integration with existing features:**
- How would this work with current wiki linking?
- Would this affect search functionality?
- Any impact on authentication or sharing?
- Compatibility with current document structure?

## Alternative Solutions
**Describe alternatives you've considered:**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Existing workarounds:**
If there are any current ways to achieve similar functionality, please describe them.

## Technical Considerations
**Implementation thoughts (optional):**
If you have technical insights or suggestions about implementation:
- Frontend changes needed
- Backend API changes
- Database/storage considerations
- Security implications

**Breaking changes:**
- Would this require changes to existing user workflows?
- Any compatibility concerns with current installations?

## Examples/References
**Examples from other tools:**
If similar functionality exists in other wikis/tools (Obsidian, Notion, etc.), please provide:
- Tool name and feature description
- Screenshots or links (if available)
- What you like/dislike about their implementation

**Mockups or sketches:**
If you have visual ideas, please attach mockups, sketches, or detailed descriptions of the UI.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.

**Priority for you:**
- [ ] Nice to have
- [ ] Would significantly improve my workflow
- [ ] Blocking my use of Schist
- [ ] I'd be willing to contribute to this feature

## Checklist
- [ ] I have searched existing issues to ensure this feature hasn't been requested
- [ ] I have provided a clear use case and solution description
- [ ] I have considered how this fits with Schist's current feature set
- [ ] I understand this is a request and not a demand
